name: Ann Marie Petriello

residences.place: Scranton (Bunker Hill Street, Ward 10), Lackawanna Co., PA
residences.note: age 6, with parents James and Mollie and brother John

bioAdditions: Ann Marie Petriello, b. about 1934, is the same woman as M0003 'Ann Marie Genello' (see that file for the full evidence). In April 1940 she was 6, living at 1028 Bunker Hill Street, Scranton, with her parents James and Mollie and her brother John (S2). Her brother John T. Petriello Sr.'s 2025 obituary names her as 'his sister Ann Marie Genello' (S1). She married Anthony 'Zitzer' Genello about 1955-56 and was widowed in February 2024 (S3).
